analysis_description: Cellpose-derived animal-level spatial occurrence profiles; no newly trained condition classifier
caveats: Only three animals and one analyzed field per condition are available.
Water acquisition batch differs from the Sucrose/Allulose legacy Apotome batch; Water3 is a 2026 Leica SP8 acquisition. Mask-derived ratios reduce but do not eliminate acquisition confounding.
The mandatory human-accepted WATER_NPY3 DAPI mask records the modal dapi_channel model; its accepted labels define all shells and denominators.
NPY masks for E7_FR7-5 and E8_FR6-1 record dapi_channel rather than the modal cfos_channel3 Cellpose model.

The double-occurrence endpoint has unequal multivariate dispersion by the exact endpoint-matched diagnostic; PERMANOVA therefore does not distinguish condition-centroid separation from dispersion heterogeneity.
The analysis was developed after data inspection and is exploratory, not preregistered confirmatory inference.

descriptive_panel_insets.cell_value: arithmetic mean animal occurrence_percent within condition and shell
descriptive_panel_insets.color_scale: inferno; zero to endpoint-specific maximum condition mean
descriptive_panel_insets.inferential_role: descriptive only; no additional statistical test or replicate
descriptive_panel_insets.source: same animal_radial_occurrence_features.csv values shown in line profiles

determinism.allocation_order: lexicographic combinations in fixed base sample order

global_results.endpoint_label: c-FOS-positive nuclei / DAPI nuclei spatial occurrence
global_results.feature_transform: arcsin(sqrt(shell positive nuclei / shell DAPI nuclei))
global_results.multiple_testing_family: two declared global spatial occurrence profiles: c-FOS/DAPI and c-FOS+NPY/DAPI

global_results.endpoint_label: c-FOS and NPY double-positive nuclei / DAPI nuclei spatial occurrence
global_results.feature_transform: arcsin(sqrt(shell positive nuclei / shell DAPI nuclei))
global_results.multiple_testing_family: two declared global spatial occurrence profiles: c-FOS/DAPI and c-FOS+NPY/DAPI

method.coordinate_normalization: center DAPI centroid cloud and whiten by its two covariance eigenvalues; use orientation-invariant whitened radial distance
method.coordinate_source: centroids of contiguous Cellpose DAPI instance labels
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the two declared global spatial occurrence profiles
method.occurrence_denominator: DAPI nuclei in the same animal and radial shell
method.shell_definition: within-animal quantiles of whitened DAPI radial distance; approximately equal DAPI nuclei per shell
method.test: PERMANOVA pseudo-F with exhaustive animal-label allocation

multivariate_dispersion_diagnostic.exact_p: allocations with dispersion F >= observed F / 1,680
multivariate_dispersion_diagnostic.interpretation: The double-occurrence diagnostic detects unequal multivariate dispersion; its PERMANOVA result cannot be interpreted as a pure condition-centroid difference
multivariate_dispersion_diagnostic.method: For every 3/3/3 allocation, recompute each allocated group centroid in six-shell feature space, calculate animal Euclidean distances to that centroid, and apply a one-way ANOVA F to the distances
multivariate_dispersion_diagnostic.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the two endpoint-matched diagnostics

results.centroid_definition: allocation-specific condition centroid recomputed for every labeling
results.distance: Euclidean in six-shell animal feature space
results.endpoint_label: c-FOS-positive nuclei / DAPI nuclei spatial occurrence
results.feature_transform: arcsin(sqrt(shell positive nuclei / shell DAPI nuclei))
results.multiple_testing_family: two declared multivariate-dispersion diagnostics corresponding to the two spatial endpoints
results.small_sample_bias_adjustment: not applied; every allocated group has n=3, so the common sqrt(3/2) distance factor leaves F and p unchanged
results.statistic: one-way ANOVA F on Euclidean distances to allocated group centroids

results.centroid_definition: allocation-specific condition centroid recomputed for every labeling
results.distance: Euclidean in six-shell animal feature space
results.endpoint_label: c-FOS and NPY double-positive nuclei / DAPI nuclei spatial occurrence
results.feature_transform: arcsin(sqrt(shell positive nuclei / shell DAPI nuclei))
results.multiple_testing_family: two declared multivariate-dispersion diagnostics corresponding to the two spatial endpoints
results.small_sample_bias_adjustment: not applied; every allocated group has n=3, so the common sqrt(3/2) distance factor leaves F and p unchanged
results.statistic: one-way ANOVA F on Euclidean distances to allocated group centroids

registered_microscopy_insets.reason: Only one representative field per condition has an audited display registration; using those three insets beside all-nine-animal inference would imply unsupported section-level registration.
